flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:8080/ then Open the first product and store its displayed price as listed_price.
Get the displayed price of the first product and save as {{listed_price}}.
Add it to the cart without any extras.
If the cart contains anything else you did not add, @v16:"remove it".
Go to checkout and continue until the final order review page, filling any required fields with simple test text.
Do not enter payment details and do not place the order.
Store the final order total shown on the review page as final_total, and store the names of any fees added on top of the product price as extra_fees (or "none").
Get the final order total shown on the review page and save as {{final_total}}.
Get the names of any fees added on top of the product price, or "none", and save as {{extra_fees}}.
Never enter payment details and never place a real order.

summary:
Opened the first product and recorded its listed price of $49.00.
Added the product to the cart without extras; an added ShieldPlus Protection Plan was removed so that only the intended product remained.
Continued through checkout using simple test information and reached the final order review page.
Stopped before entering payment details or placing an order. The review page showed a $56.49 total, including a Service & handling fee.
one_liner: reached the final order review page on the local store

final_total.condition: The final order total shown on the review page is stored as {{final_total}}.
final_total.human_description: Reading the final order total from the review page

extra_fees.query: the names of non-free fee line items in the review page order summary
extra_fees.condition: The names of any fees added on top of the product price, or "none", are stored as {{extra_fees}}.
extra_fees.human_description: Reading additional fees from the review page
extra_fees.code_js: (() => { const fees = [...el(9).querySelectorAll('.row:not(.total)')].filter(row => { const values = row.querySelectorAll('span'); const label = values[0]?.textContent.trim() ?? ''; const amount = values[1]?.textContent.trim() ?? ''; return values.length >= 2 && amount !== 'FREE' && !label.includes('×'); }).map(row => row.querySelector('span')?.textContent.trim()).filter(Boolean); return fees.length ? fees.join(', ') : 'none'; })()
